svg.text: Cost grows as length^1.40 (dashed), from a 7 m starfighter to the 120 km Death Star: far below the length³ a price by volume would give, so the big ships are cheap per cubic
metre. Hyperdrive class hardly follows the price: the Millennium Falcon (class 0.5) is among the cheapest and fastest. Ten ships have no cost ('unknown'), among them Slave 1 and
the TIE Advanced. Click a ship for Wookieepedia.
